svg.title: The deterministic screenshot, with and without gizmos
svg.desc: Two run-length-encoded renders of the game's headless shot. The upper panel shows the arena: a floor with kerbs, eight pillars, ten remaining orbs and the amber rover. The lower panel adds the gameplay gizmos: pickup spheres round every orb and the rover, a line to the nearest orb, and red oriented boxes round every pillar. Neither picture carries a score, because a headless run has no SDL_Renderer and the HUD is drawn by SDL.
